title: Water Rotation Log Gallons Rotated Leaderboard
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=water:rotation gallons_rotated=*
| stats sum(gallons_rotated) as total_value, avg(gallons_rotated) as avg_value by storage_location
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks storage location values by total and average gallons rotated across water rotation log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `gallons_rotated` values for each water rotation log event and review total and average gallons rotated by storage location.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total gallons rotated.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which storage location shows the biggest gallons rotated numbers in your water rotation log data.
